2027-01-11.title: Second Monday of Denha
2027-01-11.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: When you come together as a church, there are divisions among you
That they may all be one
2027-01-11.verse: that they may all be one. As you, Father, are in me and I am in you, may they also be in us, so that the world may believe that you have sent me.
theo: At the Last Supper, before he goes out to his Passion, Jesus prays not only for the apostles but “also on behalf of those who will believe in me through their word”: that is, for us. And what does he ask? “That they may all be one. As you, Father, are in me and I am in you, may they also be in us, so that the world may believe that you have sent me.” The unity of Christians is not a matter of good organisation; its source and model is the communion of the Father and the Son. And it has a missionary purpose: when Christians are one, the world can recognise that Jesus comes from the Father. Denha is the season of manifestation, and our unity is one of the ways in which Christ is still made manifest.

Paul shows us the opposite picture. In Corinth, “when you come together as a church, I hear that there are divisions among you”. At the very meal of the Lord the better-off eat their own supper first, and “one goes hungry and another becomes drunk”. Paul is blunt: “Do you show contempt for the church of God and humiliate those who have nothing?” To divide the Body at the table of the Body is a contradiction. Our parishes and families are not free of such divisions: rich and poor, old families and newcomers, groups that no longer speak to one another, quarrels even about holy things. Jesus' prayer is for us. The Holy Qurbana is the sacrament of unity, and we cannot receive it with a clear heart while we despise a brother or sister.
outline: Ask: what divides people in our parish or our family?
Point 2 · That they may all be one
Point 3 · So that the world may believe
live: Before you next go to Holy Qurbana, take one step towards someone you are divided from: a call, a greeting, a word of apology.
Pray each day for the unity of all Christians, preparing for the Week of Prayer for Christian Unity (18–25 January).
2027-01-11.prayer: Lord Jesus, on the night before you suffered you prayed that we may all be one, as you and the Father are one. Heal the divisions in my family, my parish and your Church, and never let me despise a brother or sister at your table, so that the world may believe that the Father has sent you. Amen.
altar: Paul warns that division at the Lord's supper contradicts its very meaning. In the Holy Qurbana we exchange the peace before the Anaphora and pray for the peace and unity of the Church before we approach the one Bread.

quick: Jesus prays that all who believe may be one.
Our unity flows from the communion of the Father and the Son.
Division at the Lord's table contradicts the Body of Christ.
2027-01-11.action: Take one step today towards someone you are divided from.
2027-01-11.question: Is there someone I despise or avoid, while we come to the same altar?

family.explain: Before he died, Jesus prayed for us! He asked the Father that all who believe in him would be one family, so that the world would believe.
family.intention: We pray that our family may be united and peaceful.
family.ask: Ask: “Is there someone we need to make peace with?”

illus: In a parish near Pala two families had not spoken for years because of a boundary wall. During the parish retreat the older man crossed the church after Holy Qurbana and offered his hand to his neighbour. The next week the wall was still there, but a small gate had been cut into it.

pm.open: Lord Jesus, you prayed that we may all be one. Gather us in your love and heal what divides us. Amen.
share: When you come together as a church, there are divisions among you (1 Corinthians 11:18). Where do I contribute to division?
That they may all be one (John 17:21). How can I serve unity in my family and parish?
So that the world may know that you have sent me (John 17:23). Does my life make Jesus believable?
interc: For the unity of all Christians.
For our Syro-Malabar Church, that she may be one in faith and love around her shepherds.
For families divided by quarrels over property or pride.
For the poor who are humiliated or forgotten in our communities.
For our group, that we may be one as the Father and the Son are one.
pm.close: Father, your Son prayed that we may be one in you. Heal our divisions and make us a sign of your love, so that the world may believe. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

homily: Dear friends, the Corinthians were a lively, gifted community, yet Paul has to write to them: when you come together as a church, I hear that there are divisions among you (1 Corinthians 11:18). At the Lord's supper the better-off ate their own meal while the poor went hungry.
Paul asks: do you show contempt for the church of God and humiliate those who have nothing? (1 Corinthians 11:22). The meal of unity had become a sign of division.

In the Gospel Jesus prays for us, who believe through the apostles' word: that they may all be one, as you, Father, are in me and I am in you, so that the world may believe that you have sent me (John 17:21). Our unity is meant to be a window through which the world sees God.
In a week the Church begins the Week of Prayer for Christian Unity. Let us start at home: one phone call, one greeting, one apology before we next come to the altar. Amen.
kids: Children, before Jesus died, he prayed for you! He asked his Father that we would all be one big family. So be kind to everyone, even the child nobody plays with.

intro: Theme: “That they may all be one.”
Jesus' prayer for unity, and Paul's warning against division at the Lord's table.

sub: Contempt for the poor is contempt for the Church.
q: How very good and pleasant it is when kindred live together in unity!
For, to begin with, when you come together as a church, I hear that there are divisions among you; and to some extent I believe it.
points.apply: Make peace with one person before your next Holy Qurbana.

sub: The Father in the Son, the Son in the Father.
Unity is a gift before it is a task.
q: I will make them one nation in the land, on the mountains of Israel; and one king shall be king over them all. Never again shall they be two nations, and never again shall they be divided into two kingdoms.
that they may all be one. As you, Father, are in me and I am in you, may they also be in us, so that the world may believe that you have sent me.
points.apply: Pray daily for the unity of all Christians.

points.h: So that the world may believe
q: he says, “It is too light a thing that you should be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob and to restore the survivors of Israel; I will give you as a light to the nations, that my salvation may reach to the end of the earth.”
I in them and you in me, that they may become completely one, so that the world may know that you have sent me and have loved them even as you have loved me.
points.apply: Show kindness this week to someone outside your usual circle.

concl: Unity is Jesus' own prayer and the Holy Spirit's gift.
A united Church makes Christ believable to the world.
2027-01-11.resolve: Before the Unity Octave begins, be reconciled with one person and pray daily for Christian unity.
